abstract: OBJECTIVE: Ovarian dermoid cysts are one of the most common germ cell tumors in women. The aim of the study was to analyze the use of laparoscopy in dermoid cysts treatment in women of reproductive age. MATERIAL AND METHODS: The studied material consisted of 95 patients, aged 17-49, operated on because of dermoid cyst suspicion at the 1st Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Medical University of Warsaw, in the years 1996-2005. All the patients had pre-operative CA-125 antigen evaluation and transvaginal sonography with Doppler assessment of the ovarian pathology. All the women with tumors less than 8 cm in diameter were qualified for laparoscopic management. RESULTS: The majority of patients were below 40 years of age (86 women; 90.5%). Out of 95 studied cases, 93 (97.9%) had the cyst removed during laparoscopy, mostly elective. Dermoid cyst enucleation was the most commonly applied procedure, while oophorectomy was the least frequent. The whole gonad was removed in 33 patients (34.7%), generally because of the total loss of functional ovarian tissue surrounding the cyst (28 women; 29.5%). All the extracted material was submitted for a histopathological examination--the diagnosis of mature ovarian cystic teratoma was confirmed in 100% of cases. The correspondence of pre-operative sonographic imaging and intraoperative macroscopic assessment was evaluated. In 85 (89.5%) operated patients an ovarian tumor was earlier described as a dermoid cyst. CONCLUSIONS: Laparoscopic treatment of ovarian dermoid cysts is a safe method, offering many advantages in comparison to classical surgery. However, proper early qualification, based on medical history, gynecological and sonographic examination is of great importance.

目的：生殖年齢の女性における卵巣類皮嚢腫の治療における腹腔鏡手術の利用を分析すること。
材料と方法：対象は、1996年から2005年にかけてワルシャワ医科大学産婦人科学第1講座において、卵巣類皮嚢腫の疑いで手術を受けた17～49歳の患者95例である。全患者が術前にCA-125抗原の評価と、卵巣病変のドプラ評価を伴う経膣超音波検査を受けた。8cm未満の腫瘍をもつ全女性が腹腔鏡下治療の対象となった。
結果：患者の大半は40歳未満(86例、90.5%)であった。95例のうち93例(97.9%)では腹腔鏡下に嚢腫が摘出され、ほとんどが待機的手術であった。類皮嚢腫核出術が最も多く施行された術式であり、卵巣摘出術が最も少なかった。34.7%(33例)では卵巣全体が摘出され、一般的には嚢腫周囲の機能的卵巣組織が完全に失われたこと(28例、29.5%)が理由であった。摘出された全標本は病理組織学的検査に提出され、成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の診断は100%の症例で確認された。術前の超音波検査所見と術中の肉眼的評価の一致が評価された。手術を受けた患者の89.5%(85例)では、卵巣腫瘍は以前に類皮嚢腫と記載されていた。
結論：卵巣類皮嚢腫の腹腔鏡手術は安全な方法であり、従来の手術と比べて多くの利点がある。ただし、病歴、婦人科的および超音波検査に基づく適切な早期の適応判断が非常に重要である。
